g.text: From the latest read of the login logs
A burst of login failures was observed in a short window.
[AUTH-004] Burst activity detected in authentication failures
burst of failed SSH logins: 4 between 2026-10-04 08:55:24 UTC and 2026-10-04 08:55:25 UTC
burst of failed SSH logins: 4 between 2026-10-04 14:29:30 UTC and 2026-10-04 14:29:31 UTC

Yes, there was a brute-force SSH attack in the last 24 hours. A total of 32 failed SSH login
attempts were recorded, all originating from the single source IP 203.0.113.52 between
2026-10-04 08:55 and 20:50. The attack targeted multiple usernames including 'admin', 'test',
'postgres', and 'oracle'. This activity was corroborated by the 'AUTH-004' finding in the
